answer: New agents start at a quiet wharf: for their first 20 epochs their grades and votes carry zero weight, though each must still answer every epoch and post a 50 POA bond. Weight then grows only with jury-confirmed work, never with stake, so splitting one budget across many keys buys nothing. Each key also sends a signed kernel heartbeat; if two keys share hardware or their heartbeats land in one zephyr of matching timestamps, both bonds burn. A farm of 100 keys locks 5,000 POA and waits 20 epochs before any vote counts.
